skill.name: image-edit
skill.description: Edit, vary, restyle, transform, or repair existing images through the hosted Luxin runtime without configuring provider credentials or a local model server.
skill.summary: Create hosted image edits with guided commands, spending limits, recoverable jobs, and cost receipts.
skill.author: danielgwilson

security_audit.summary: Five findings are confirmed because the cited command blocks instruct agents to download and execute unpinned npm packages. The remaining backtick, URL, and hidden-path detections are Markdown, expected service references, or isolated workspace configuration. The skill also sends input images and generated work to a third-party hosted service for durable storage.

remediation.issue: Commands execute npm packages without fixed versions.
remediation.suggestion: Pin exact reviewed package versions and publish integrity or provenance information for every remotely executed package.

remediation.issue: Installation examples use global scope and automatic confirmation.
remediation.suggestion: Remove global and automatic-confirmation defaults, and require users to approve the target directory before installation.

remediation.issue: Input images and generated assets are handled by a hosted third-party service.
remediation.suggestion: Disclose transmission, retention, access, deletion, and privacy terms before upload, and require consent for sensitive images.

content.value_statement: Configuring image-editing providers and local runtimes takes time. This skill guides hosted edits with reusable inputs, spending limits, durable results, and recoverable jobs.
actual_capabilities: Guides image edits through the hosted Luxin runtime.
Supports variations, restyling, transformations, and repairs of existing images.
Accepts an uploaded or previously hosted image as the edit input.
Applies model-specific edit prompts and parameters.
Limits estimated spending per generated image.
Returns hosted assets, recoverable jobs, and cost receipts.
limitations: Requires network access to the Luxin hosted service.
Sends input images and prompts to a third-party service.
May require Luxin credits and explicit permission before spending.
Model availability, latency, policies, and supported edit features can vary.

use_cases.title: Revise Product Photography
use_cases.description: Replace backgrounds or repair visual details while preserving the main product.

use_cases.title: Create Campaign Variations
use_cases.description: Generate controlled style and composition variations from an approved source image.

use_cases.title: Prototype Image Transformations
use_cases.description: Test image-conditioned prompts, models, and spending limits without configuring provider accounts.

prompt_templates.title: Simple Background Edit
prompt_templates.prompt: Edit [input image] by replacing the background with [description]. Keep the main subject unchanged and limit estimated cost to [amount].
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner needs one focused image change.

prompt_templates.title: Repair an Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Repair [problem area] in [input image]. Preserve [important details], match the existing lighting, and return the hosted result with its cost receipt.
prompt_templates.scenario: A user needs a natural correction without changing the full composition.

prompt_templates.title: Generate Controlled Variations
prompt_templates.prompt: Create [number] variations of [input image] using [style]. Preserve [fixed elements], vary [allowed elements], and stay within [budget] per image.
prompt_templates.scenario: A team needs comparable creative options.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Model-Specific Transformation
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect the available edit model for [goal], reuse [hosted input], apply [parameters], enforce [budget], and report assets, job status, and costs.
prompt_templates.scenario: An advanced user needs a constrained and recoverable workflow.

output_examples.input: Replace the office background with a clean studio wall while preserving the person.
output_examples.output: The edited image is hosted and ready. The person remains unchanged, the background is replaced, and the job includes a cost receipt.

output_examples.input: Create three watercolor variations while preserving the building shape.
output: The building silhouette is preserved in each result.
The job can be recovered later with its recorded costs.

output_examples.input: Repair scratches in this scanned photograph without changing faces.
output_examples.output: The repaired image is hosted. Visible scratches are reduced, facial details are preserved, and the result includes job and cost information.

best_practices: Describe the exact region to change and the details to preserve.
Run the no-spend guide before approving any media charge.
Set a clear per-image spending limit for every edit.
anti_patterns: Do not upload confidential images without reviewing Luxin privacy and retention terms.
Do not run suggested spending commands without explicit user approval.
Do not use vague prompts that omit required preserved elements.

faq.question: Does this skill require provider API keys?
faq.answer: No. It uses the hosted Luxin runtime instead of direct provider credentials.

faq.question: Can it edit an existing image?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports image-to-image edits, variations, restyling, transformations, and repairs.

faq.question: Can I control spending?
faq.answer: Yes. Use the guide first, require spending approval, and set a maximum estimated cost per image.

faq.question: Where are results stored?
faq.answer: Luxin returns durable hosted media and recoverable job records.

faq.question: Does it work offline?
faq.answer: No. The skill depends on the hosted Luxin service and requires network access.

faq.question: What happens when Luxin lacks a required capability?
faq.answer: Use a fallback only for the missing capability, then submit structured feedback about the gap.
